At Ballstad, our primary focus is delivering the highest quality and freshest omega-3 and collagen products in the market. Our dedication to excellence begins in Norway, where our products are carefully crafted. 

With our Ballstad Ambassador affiliate program we want to offer you:

-          30% First order commission

-          15% Lifetime commission

-          Costumer get 10% discount on first order.

-          Payout via bank or PayPal 

Why Ballstad?

We go above and beyond industry standards to ensure that our ingredients are free from environmental and oxidative impurities.

By implementing stringent measures throughout our production process, we guarantee the purity and freshness of our omega-3 supplements.

·      100% fresh Norwegian highly concentrated and purified omega-3 oil, encapsulated in fish gelatin, produced in pharma-compliant quality systems, where every batch is analyzed and made available for the costumer

·      One of the lowest TOTOX levels (oxidation) in the market (avg. 3 to 4)

·      In our quest to deliver ingredients free from environmental and oxidative impurities, we go above and beyond industry standards. Purified to the level where PCB, dioxins and heavy metals are almost or undetectable

·      Only omega-3 oil which monitor and measure trans fat and makes the measurement available

·      Small capsules that are easy to swallow

·      Guaranteed quality and satisfaction

·      In conclusion, Ballstad Omega-3 stands out from competitors with its exceptional purity, high omega-3 concentration, sustainable sourcing, advanced extraction technology, independent quality assurance, and proven consumer satisfaction.
